cero.definition:
n large edible mackerel of temperate United States coastal Atlantic waters
n large mackerel with long pointed snout; important food and game fish of the eastern Atlantic coast southward to Brazil

cerograph.translation: n. (图画或字的)蜡刻,蜡画术

cerographic.translation: a. 蜡画(术)的;蜡雕(术)的[亦作 cerographical] adj.

cerography.definition:
n. The art of making characters or designs in, or with,
   wax.
n. A method of making stereotype plates from inscribed
   sheets of wax.
cerography.translation: n. 蜡写法, 蜡画术

ceroid pigment.translation: [医] 蜡样色素(鼠肝硬变色素)

cerolite.definition:
n. A hydrous silicate of magnesium, allied to serpentine,
   occurring in waxlike masses of a yellow or greenish color.

ceroma.definition:
n. The unguent (a composition of oil and wax) with which
   wrestlers were anointed among the ancient Romans.
n. That part of the baths and gymnasia in which bathers and
   wrestlers anointed themselves.
n. The cere of birds.

ceroplastic.definition:
a. Relating to the art of modeling in wax.
a. Modeled in wax; as, a ceroplastic figure.
ceroplastic.translation:
a. 蜡塑的
n. 蜡塑术, 蜡制品

ceroplasty.definition: n. The art of modeling in wax.

cerosic acid.translation: [化] 蔗蜡酸; 廿四酸; 廿四烷酸

cerosin.definition:
n. A waxy substance obtained from the bark of the sugar cane,
   and crystallizing in delicate white laminae.

cerotene.definition:
n. A white waxy solid obtained from Chinese wax, and by the
   distillation of cerotin.

cerotic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or derived from, beeswax or Chinese wax;
   as, cerotic acid or alcohol.
cerotic.translation: a. 蜂蜡的, 出自蜂蜡的

cerotic acid.translation:
[化] 蜡酸; 二十六酸; 二十六烷酸
[医] 蜡酸, 廿六酸

cerotin.definition:
n. A white crystalline substance, C27H55.OH, obtained from
   Chinese wax, and regarded as an alcohol of the marsh gas series; --
   called also cerotic alcohol, ceryl alcohol.
cerotin.translation: 蜡精, 甘油三蜡酸酯

cerous.definition: a of or relating to or containing cerium with valence 3
cerous.translation: a. [化](正)铈的, 三价铈的
